title: 第两千六百六十一章先天龙体第两千六百六十章女婿给岳母一件防身的宝物也很正常对吧
slug: 开局成为首座签到极道帝兵
lines: 敖楚歌来自禁忌之地的至高圣龙族，乃龙族之首，杀过的龙族不计其数，可他也从未见过如天命无极这种龙族血脉。
天命无极似乎已经不属于黑龙了！
但他看得出，天命无极的血脉异变应该还未真正完成，还是有部分黑龙血脉在。
“用先祖的血脉让你很骄傲？”天命无极说道。
“什么意思？”敖楚歌沉声道。
“你无需明白。”天命无极道。
敖楚歌蹙眉。
天命无极的神态让他非常不悦，两人对峙，好像他才是那个占据血脉优势的人。
“嗷吼！”
背后的圣龙图腾发出更加猛烈的咆哮，两界观战的生灵愈发的难受，相隔这么远，只是一道吼声，竟就能压制他们！
“不用尝试了，当今天地间的龙族，无一人有资格压制我，你也不行。”天命无极道。
“不可能！”敖楚歌不信。
就算天命无极的血脉再怎么异变，那也只会在至高圣龙族之下，怎会不被压制？
黑龙族本就是低等龙族，血脉如何异变，又怎能摆脱掉“低等”二字？
“嗷吼！”
天命无极背后浮现巨大的图腾，区别于黑龙族的图腾，他背后盘旋黑龙身上有无数金纹，威严异常，独属于他一人。
这一声龙吼是对至高圣龙的回应，敖楚歌色变，身体颤了颤，感知到了可怕的威严。
他身为至高圣龙，竟然在一只低等黑龙的身上感受到了威胁？
背后的圣龙图腾也感受到了威胁，盘旋而上，自上而下俯视黑龙图腾，发出了更加威严的咆哮，龙威不断压下。
天命无极踏步，丝毫不受影响。
敖楚歌冷哼一声，先一步出手，裹挟着龙拳杀来，宇宙海动荡，被龙威淹没。
“什么？”
刚刚靠近天命无极，他的手臂就一阵酥麻，不自主的发颤。
他瞪大眼睛，满脸不可置信。
他太清楚这是什么了。
他的血脉竟在忌惮天命无极！
他的至高圣龙血脉竟在忌惮一只黑龙？
“不可能！”
敖楚歌怒吼，克制血脉的悸动，打出至高圣龙拳，压盖一切。
天命无极轻易便接下至高圣龙拳，看着愤怒的敖楚歌，“继承始祖衣钵之人，又如何会是超越始祖之人的对手？”
他的背后，金纹黑龙咆哮。
敖楚歌被这声龙吼狠狠冲击，下一刻，他倒飞而回，胸口出现一个可怕血洞。
九玄祖域观战的强者全部起身，满脸不可置信，至高圣龙族竟反被压制了？
这怎么可能！
开天、曲澜、韩诸等人都皱起眉头。
这一幕出乎所有人预料。
这场双龙争霸，似乎在朝预想不到的方向发展！
天命无极杀来，无比强势，龙威遮天，泯灭一切。
敖楚歌体内的血脉乱颤，这是他从未有过的感觉，此刻竟发生在他身上。
“不完全的异变凭什么可压制我？”
敖楚歌大吼，至高圣龙血脉沸腾，终于挡住了天命无极的压制。
天命无极的血脉异变还未彻底完成，这也是他能挡住压制的根本原因。
对此，天命无极也不意外。
不过压制与否对他来说都无所谓，正面一战，敖楚歌也不是他的对手。
content_en:
Ao Chuge came from the Supreme Holy Dragon Clan in the Forbidden Land, and was the leader of the dragon clan. He had killed countless dragon clans, but he had never seen a dragon clan bloodline like Tianming Wuji.
It seems that Destiny Wuji no longer belongs to the Black Dragon!
But he could tell that the bloodline mutation of Tianming Wuji had not been truly completed, and there was still some black dragon bloodline.
"Using the blood of your ancestors makes you very proud?" Tianming Wuji said.
"What do you mean?" Ao Chuge said in a deep voice.
"You don't need to understand." Tianming Wuji said.
Ao Chuge frowned.
Tian Ming Wuji's demeanor made him very displeased, and the two faced off as if he was the one with the bloodline advantage.
"Ouch!"
The Holy Dragon Totem behind him roared even more fiercely, and the creatures watching the battle in the two realms became increasingly uncomfortable. Even though they were so far apart, just one roar could suppress them!
"No need to try. No one among the dragon clan in the world today has the qualifications to suppress me, not even you." Tianming Wuji said.
"Impossible!" Ao Chuge didn't believe it.
Even if the bloodline of Tianming Wuji changes, it will only be under the Supreme Holy Dragon Clan. How can it not be suppressed?
The Black Dragon Tribe is originally a low-grade dragon tribe. How can the bloodline change and get rid of the word "low-grade"?
"Ouch!"
A huge totem appeared behind Tianming Wuji, which was different from the totems of the black dragon clan. The black dragon hovering behind him had countless golden patterns on its body. It was extremely majestic and belonged to him alone.
This dragon roar was a response to the Supreme Holy Dragon. Ao Chuge's expression changed, his body trembled, and he felt the terrible majesty.
As the Supreme Holy Dragon, he actually felt threatened by a low-level black dragon?
The Holy Dragon Totem behind also felt the threat. It circled upwards, looked down at the Black Dragon Totem from top to bottom, and let out a more majestic roar. The dragon's power kept suppressing it.
The fate of destiny is infinite and unaffected at all.
Ao Chuge snorted coldly and took the first step, using the dragon fist to kill him. The cosmic sea was turbulent and was overwhelmed by the dragon's power.
"What?"
As soon as he got close to Tianming Wuji, his arms felt numb and he trembled involuntarily.
His eyes widened with disbelief on his face.
He knew exactly what it was.
His bloodline is actually afraid of Tianming Wuji!
His supreme holy dragon bloodline is actually afraid of a black dragon?
"Impossible!"
Ao Chuge roared, restraining the throbbing of his blood, and unleashed the Supreme Holy Dragon Fist to suppress everything.
Tianming Wuji easily took the Supreme Holy Dragon Fist and looked at the angry Ao Chuge, "How can a person who inherits the mantle of the ancestor be the opponent of someone who surpasses the ancestor?"
Behind him, the golden-patterned black dragon roared.
Ao Chuge was severely impacted by the dragon's roar. The next moment, he flew back and a terrible bloody hole appeared in his chest.
"Hiss!"
All the powerful men in the Jiuxuan Ancestral Domain who were watching the battle stood up with disbelief on their faces. The Supreme Holy Dragon Clan was actually suppressed?
How is this possible!
Kaitian, Qu Lan, Han Zhu and others all frowned.
This scene was beyond everyone's expectations.
This two-dragon struggle for hegemony seems to be developing in an unexpected direction!
The destiny of Wuji comes to kill, extremely powerful, the dragon's power covers the sky, and destroys everything.
The blood in Ao Chuge's body was trembling. This was something he had never felt before, and it happened to him at this moment.
"Why can an incomplete mutation suppress me?"
Ao Chuge roared, and the blood of the Supreme Holy Dragon boiled, finally blocking the suppression of Tianming Wuji.
Tianming Wuji's bloodline mutation has not yet been completely completed, which is also the fundamental reason why he can block the suppression.
Destiny Wuji is not surprised by this.
But it didn't matter to him whether he was suppressed or not. In a head-on battle, Ao Chuge was no match for him.
